title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect Heimdall to CI, trace tools and webhooks.

ci.heading: Gate pull requests with Heimdall
ci.intro: Adds a workflow that re-checks your agent on every pull request and comments the verdict.
ci.modeRecorded: Recorded (re-check a sealed experiment, no runner needed)
ci.modeLive: Live (fresh baseline vs candidate on a self-hosted runner)
ci.installInSettings: GitHub is connected. Pick the repository, base branch and mode in Settings > GitHub to open the install pull request.
ci.manual: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server. Copy the workflow below into .github/workflows/heimdall.yml in your repository by hand.
ci.notConnected: Connect GitHub in Settings > GitHub to open the install pull request from there. Until then you can copy the workflow below into your repository by hand.

exports.heading: Export results and traces
exports.intro: Runs in the background. The file appears below when ready.

formats.otlp: OTLP traces (Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, Jaeger, any OpenTelemetry backend)

exports.payloads: Include tool arguments and results (redacted and capped)
exports.noExperiments: No experiment yet. Run one first, then export it here.
exports.empty: No export yet. Pick a format and an experiment above, then press Export.
exports.name: File

webhooks.heading: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Each URL gets a signed JSON event.
webhooks.hostedNote: This server delivers only to public https URLs.
webhooks.secretOnce: Signing secret, shown once. Store it now:
webhooks.empty: No webhook yet. Add one to get a POST when an experiment finishes.
webhooks.signing: Verify X-Heimdall-Signature: sha256 HMAC of "<X-Heimdall-Timestamp>.<body>" with the webhook's secret.

errors.load: Could not load this section. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, check that the server is running.
errors.adminOnly: Changing webhooks needs the admin role. Ask an org admin.

webhooks.desc: Get a signed POST when an experiment finishes.
